messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alerting: elevated delivery latency observed for notification channels (email/SMS/webhook). Some alerts queued >5m. https://status.pagerduty.com/ :rotating_light:

jules_oncall: i'm seeing it in my phone. two alerts popped at once at 14:01 when they should have been at 13:50. Are we missing anything urgent?

alan_eng: same. bridge shows a backlog of PD webhook events arriving in bursts. ack timestamps look scrambled (ACKs arriving after triggers).

rachel_sre: checking routing — our PD escalation policies look unchanged. this smells like PD-side queuing. opening INF-2025-058 to track customer impact.

pagerduty-bot: PD Incident: "Delayed notification delivery" - Some customers may experience increased latency. Updates expected. (automated)

jules_oncall: any chance these failed deliveries triggered duplicate incident creation in our system? saw one alert create two incidents in the dashboard.

ops-bridge: yes, duplicates are being created because event IDs are slightly different on PD replays. we can enable dedupe-by-alert-title for 10m as temporary. want me to flip?

alan_eng: please do it. also limit webhook retries to avoid hammering our ingesters while PD recovers.

ops-bridge: patch applied: dedupe_window_minutes=10, webhook_retry_limit=2. monitoring for false negatives.

jules_oncall: i've manually paged mobile-only ops for the active P0. they acknowledged. If PD SMS is hosed, manual pages will continue until cleared.

rachel_sre: note for INF ticket: customer "NimbleApps" reported an alert slide between 13:46 and 14:05 reaching them at 14:06 via email. logging exact timestamps.

alan_eng: we should also consider immediate fallback: post urgent alerts to our internal SMS provider (Twilio) and to the paid on-call phone tree. small script: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.internal/sms -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"group":"oncall-sre","body":"URGENT: <alert-id> - fallback notify"}'
```

jules_oncall: only for P0/P1 until PD confirms. i'll coordinate who gets manual pages.

pagerduty-bot: PD Support Ticket PD-78892 created and acknowledged. They report increased backlog in event ingestion.

customer-success: flagged customers that might be impacted. draft message ready: "We experienced delayed notification delivery between 13:40–14:10 UTC due to third-party alerting provider issues. We are actively monitoring and will follow up with exact timeline."

rachel_sre: quick risk check: are there any customers who didn't get any alert (i.e., missed entirely)? so far looks like delayed rather than dropped. mark for legal/ops if SLA considered missed.

alan_eng: adding instrumentation: log raw PD event IDs and arrival times to INF-2025-058 so we can compare PD timestamps vs our ingress.

ops-bridge: bridging note: temporarily suppressed webhook-based auto-resolve for 20m to avoid weird cancels when PD replays old resolve events.

jules_oncall: handoff: i need to step out at 14:20 UTC. @alan_eng can you take on-call until 15:00 and watch for PD escalation?

alan_eng: taking over. i'll keep the INF ticket updated and coordinate with PD support to request a critical call if delays don't improve in 30m.

pagerduty-bot: PD Update: mitigation in progress; delivery latency improving (median <20s over last 5m). Continuing to monitor.

jules_oncall: good to hear. adding my late-arrival examples to the INF ticket before i go. thanks team. :wave:

customer-success: holding off on customer-wide email until PD confirms root cause and timeline. will issue a targeted note to customers who reported out-of-band if needed.

rachel_sre: follow-ups captured: 1) add PD delivery latency alert, 2) add early SMS fallback option for P0 rules, 3) update incident runbook for third-party alert provider degradation.

alan_eng: noted. if PD status flips back to degraded we'll trigger escalation to PD SRE with our event logs. for now, monitoring.

ops-bridge: last check: no new duplicate incidents since dedupe flip. will revert dedupe setting after 24h if stable.

rachel_sre: closing this thread for now; last_message_ts set. INF-2025-058 will cover timeline + customer impact + postmortem actions.

alan_eng: :thumbsup: thanks all, keeping watch."
